notes: Per-mode binary-judge evals for all 9 modes. v1 (#1125): full / timeline / attribution plus the ADR-051 MCP-degradation case (ids 1-4). v2 (#1126): comms / plan <name> / raid / sources plus the plan no-arg 'which plan?' prompt case (ids 5-9). v3 rollup slice: the rollup mode (mode 8) 3 sub-modes — --scope portfolio (compose-not-absorb via weekly-status-rollup, staged bridge-file proposal), --scope project --depth full (sub-entity scan -> TRACKER_UPDATES), --scope project --depth status (status-fields-only quick refresh) (ids 10-12). v4 structure slice: the structure mode (mode 9) entity-completeness audit across 3 distinct structural-violation classes — missing entity (typed edge to an absent entity), empty required field (empty slot, presence failure only), broken relationship (populated FK unresolvable while its target tier IS populated) (ids 13-15). Fixtures, per-mode judge prompts, and case section-membership specs live under fixtures/, judges/, and cases/. Stakeholder names in fixtures are sanitized.

evals.name: full-pre-cutover-categorization
evals.expected_output: full mode runs the timeline + attribution checks and merges them into the 5-section output (## Confirmed / ## Auto-Actionable / ## Decisions / ## Unknowns / ## Rollup-Diffs, in order). The two-source-corroborated, more-recent date drift (PROJECT.md+carry-forward April 2 vs Jira+Smartsheet April 9) lands in ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S2] with a TRACKER_UPDATES: block. The newer-source owner replacement ([OWNER-A]->[OWNER-B] from Confluence on-call) lands in ## Decisions [confidence: MEDIUM · S2]. The 'Wednesday April 2' weekday mismatch (April 2 2026 is a Thursday) is flagged in ## Decisions [confidence: HIGH · S2]. The empty-owner BLK-014 lands in ## Unknowns with what was searched. A PROJECT.md date diff is staged in ## Rollup-Diffs (diff-only, never written). Seeded-clean items (UAT Lead [OWNER-C], BLK-021) are NOT flagged. Every finding carries a [confidence: … · S…] label. PASS iff all seeded drifts are in their expected section and zero clean items are flagged. Judge: judges/full.md; case: cases/full-pre-cutover.yaml.

evals.name: timeline-day-of-week-and-no-generalized-dates
evals.expected_output: timeline mode audits every surfaced date. It validates day-of-week: the 'Wednesday April 2' entry is flagged because April 2 2026 is a Thursday (S2). It refuses generalized ranges: no date is reported as 'week of …' or any relative range; an unverifiable date would route to ## Unknowns with what was searched. The two-source-corroborated, more-recent date drift (April 2 -> April 9) lands in ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S2] with a TRACKER_UPDATES: block. A currency mismatch is S2 (never S3 on elapsed time alone). Correctly-dated items are NOT flagged. PASS iff date drifts categorized correctly, the weekday mismatch is flagged, and no generalized range appears. Judge: judges/timeline.md; case: cases/timeline-pre-cutover.yaml.

evals.name: attribution-missing-owner-no-fabrication
evals.expected_output: attribution mode audits every item's owner. The empty BLK-014 owner is flagged and routed to ## Unknowns with what was searched (Jira assignee / tracker owner column / on-call page) — never silently passed. The newer-source replacement ([OWNER-B] from the Confluence on-call page) is proposed in ## Decisions [confidence: MEDIUM · S2] WITH its source cited — and only because a canonical source names it. No owner is fabricated from role, adjacency, or transcript mention. The seeded-clean UAT Lead [OWNER-C] is NOT flagged. PASS iff the missing owner is flagged, any replacement is source-cited, no owner is fabricated, and clean owners are not flagged. Judge: judges/attribution.md; case: cases/attribution-pre-cutover.yaml.

evals.name: mcp-degradation-cap-and-banner
evals.prompt: /health-check full --scope Synthetic-UAT  (against fixtures/uat-window-mcp-degraded.md; Jira UNREACHABLE at run start)
evals.expected_output: The run probes connectors at start, finds Jira unreachable, and emits the header banner '[MCP UNAVAILABLE: Jira] — findings limited to local sources'. The UAT exit date (PROJECT.md + tracker + Smartsheet agree; April 17 2026 is correctly a Friday) lands in ## Confirmed [confidence: HIGH · S0]. The defect-owner disagreement ([OWNER-D] vs [OWNER-E]) whose only tiebreaker (Jira assignee) is unreachable is CAPPED at MEDIUM and routed to ## Decisions with an inline [MCP UNAVAILABLE: Jira] tag — it does NOT appear in ## Auto-Actionable, and no TRACKER_UPDATES: block is emitted for it. HEADLINE ASSERTION: degradation reduced coverage (the finding moved to Decisions, MEDIUM) but did NOT silently downgrade rigor into auto-action (ADR-051 §4). PASS iff the banner fired, the degraded finding is MEDIUM in ## Decisions, and ## Auto-Actionable is empty of it. Judge: judges/full.md; case: cases/full-mcp-degraded.yaml.

evals.name: comms-lifecycle-classification-status-only
evals.expected_output: comms mode classifies each communication's lifecycle state. COM-031 (SENT April 13, response expected, none in 11 days) is a stale-SENT -> ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S2] with a status-only TRACKER_UPDATES: block routed to /comms-writer. COM-034 (READY, never sent, past its window) is an unsent-READY -> ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S1]. COM-033 (DRAFT for the passed April 13 window) is an obsolete-DRAFT -> ## Decisions [confidence: MEDIUM · S2] (reschedule-or-obsolete is an operator call). The TRACKER_UPDATES: block proposes status changes only — the skill never drafts or sends a comm. No response is asserted where no source attests it. Seeded-clean COM-032 (recent, no response needed) is NOT flagged. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff lifecycle states classified correctly, status-only updates, no inferred response, clean comm not flagged. Judge: judges/comms.md; case: cases/comms-hypercare.yaml.

evals.name: plan-named-promised-vs-reflected
evals.expected_output: plan mode audits ONLY the named Hypercare Plan (not a sweep of all plans) for promised-vs-trackers-reflected delta. The war-room staffing rota promised by April 15 is absent from the tracker AND has no Confluence rota page (two sources agree absent) -> ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S2] with a TRACKER_UPDATES: block. The hypercare exit report promised by April 22 (not drafted) may have been deliberately deferred -> ## Decisions [confidence: MEDIUM · S2] (cautious bias — not asserted 'failed'). The daily defect triage stand-up (HC-002 active in the tracker) lands in ## Confirmed [confidence: HIGH · S0]. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff the named plan is scoped correctly, deltas categorized with cautious bias, and the delivered item is not flagged. Judge: judges/plan.md; case: cases/plan-hypercare.yaml.

evals.name: plan-no-arg-which-plan-prompt
evals.prompt: /health-check plan --scope Synthetic-Hypercare  (NO plan name supplied; against fixtures/hypercare-window.md)
evals.expected_output: plan invoked with no name returns an actionable 'which plan?' prompt — it names the candidate plan(s) it can see (or asks the operator to name one) and does NOT run an audit against a guessed/defaulted plan. This is the AC-2 load-bearing assertion. A clean 5-section report produced against any auto-chosen plan is an automatic FAIL. PASS iff the no-name invocation prompts rather than defaulting. Judge: judges/plan.md (Invocation B); case: cases/plan-no-arg.yaml.

evals.name: raid-guardrail-enforcement
evals.expected_output: raid mode enforces the RAID guardrails. R-PROJ-040 ('Performance may be impacted under peak load') is flagged for THREE violations — passive voice (no actor), missing owner (empty), and missing mitigation (none) -> ## Decisions [confidence: HIGH · S2]. R-PROJ-038 (last reviewed March 5, >30 days before the hypercare window) is flagged stale — a closure-or-refresh candidate per the >30d auto-escalate rule -> ## Decisions [confidence: HIGH · S2]. No risk is auto-closed (cautious bias — closing a risk needs evidence); closures route to ## Decisions, not ## Auto-Actionable. The seeded-clean R-PROJ-041 (active-voice, named owner [OWNER-F], named mitigation, reviewed April 22) is NOT flagged. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff all guardrail violations flagged (passive voice / missing owner / missing mitigation / stale), no risk auto-closed, clean entry not flagged. Judge: judges/raid.md; case: cases/raid-hypercare.yaml.

evals.name: sources-inventory-and-freshness
evals.expected_output: sources mode emits a canonical-source inventory naming its source-of-truth set — the MCP-primary set (Confluence / Jira / Smartsheet / SharePoint) plus the local fallback set — with a per-source freshness verdict (the headline deliverable). The Confluence sync timestamp recorded in PROJECT.md (April 2) is stale vs the live page (edited April 20) -> ## Auto-Actionable [confidence: HIGH · S2] with a sync-direction recommendation + TRACKER_UPDATES: block. SharePoint (no MCP connector) is listed as missing-but-expected / link-only / content-unverifiable — NOT asserted fresh. Jira sync (April 22, current) and the agreeing Smartsheet exit date land in ## Confirmed [confidence: HIGH · S0]. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff the inventory is emitted naming the source-of-truth set, the stale Confluence sync is flagged with a direction, SharePoint is flagged missing-but-expected, and fresh sources are confirmed. Judge: judges/sources.md; case: cases/sources-hypercare.yaml.

evals.name: rollup-portfolio-compose-not-absorb
evals.prompt: /health-check rollup --scope portfolio  (against fixtures/portfolio-two-project.md; two active projects with rollup entities + a stale PORTFOLIO.md)
evals.expected_output: rollup --scope portfolio audits per-project rollup-entity freshness vs PORTFOLIO.md. Synthetic-Alpha's rollup entity (refreshed 2026-04-24: Phase Hypercare, Health 🟡) is newer than PORTFOLIO.md (last updated 2026-04-13: Phase Testing, Health 🟢) -> a PORTFOLIO.md proposal (Phase Testing->Hypercare, Health 🟢->🟡). HEADLINE ASSERTION (compose-not-absorb, ADR-019): the PORTFOLIO.md composition is ROUTED to weekly-status-rollup Section 6 — NOT re-implemented inside health-check — and the staged proposal is re-homed under 08-Generated/_health-check/ and surfaced in ## Rollup-Diffs [MODERATE · HIGH]. PORTFOLIO.md is NOT written directly (bridge-file boundary, AC-3); no TRACKER_UPDATES: block is emitted for the portfolio proposal. The clean Synthetic-Beta row (matches its rollup entity) is NOT flagged. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff the proposal is composed via weekly-status-rollup and staged (not written), the aggregation is not re-implemented inside health-check, and the clean row is not flagged. Judge: judges/rollup.md (Invocation A); case: cases/rollup-portfolio.yaml.

evals.name: rollup-project-full-sub-entity-scan
evals.prompt: /health-check rollup --scope project --depth full  (active project = Synthetic-Hypercare; against fixtures/hypercare-window.md)
evals.expected_output: rollup --scope project --depth full scans the project's sub-entities — Milestones (Go-Live April 13 / Hypercare exit April 24), RAID Items (R-PROJ-040 / 041 / 038), Plans (Hypercare Plan), Resources (war-room) — and proposes a refreshed rollup entity. The proposed field changes route via a TRACKER_UPDATES: block in ## Auto-Actionable to /tracker-manager on approval — NOT ## Rollup-Diffs (reserved for PROJECT.md/PORTFOLIO.md) — and are NEVER auto-applied. CONTRACT-TOLERANT: because the portfolio-writeback rollup-contract / rollup entity is not yet shipped, the output surfaces a ## Unknowns coverage note (schema not yet shipped; fields mapped best-effort) rather than crashing or fabricating a rollup entity. Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff the full four-class sub-entity scan feeds a TRACKER_UPDATES: refresh in ## Auto-Actionable (never ## Rollup-Diffs, never auto-applied) and the absent contract degrades to a ## Unknowns coverage note. Judge: judges/rollup.md (Invocation B); case: cases/rollup-project-full.yaml.

evals.name: rollup-project-status-quick-refresh-distinct
evals.prompt: /health-check rollup --scope project --depth status  (active project = Synthetic-Cutover; against fixtures/pre-cutover.md)
evals.expected_output: rollup --scope project --depth status is the quick path — it refreshes the rollup entity's status field(s) ONLY, NOT a full Milestones/RAID/Plans/Resources re-derivation. LOAD-BEARING DISTINCTNESS ASSERTION: --depth status is observably lighter than --depth full (id 11) — it does not scan all four sub-entity classes. The proposed status change routes via a TRACKER_UPDATES: block in ## Auto-Actionable, never auto-applied, never in ## Rollup-Diffs. Contract-tolerant: the absent contract degrades to a ## Unknowns coverage note (never a crash/fabrication). Five sections in order; every finding labeled. PASS iff the refresh is status-fields-only (distinct from --depth full), routed via TRACKER_UPDATES: and never auto-applied. Judge: judges/rollup.md (Invocation C); case: cases/rollup-project-status.yaml.

evals.name: structure-missing-entity-referenced-but-absent
evals.expected_output: structure mode audits all three limbs — (a) entity present, (b) required fields populated, (c) required relationships valid — for each entity in the derived expected set. VIOLATION CLASS 1 of 3 (missing entity): MTG-104 carries a typed GENERATES edge naming a Decision id that no record instantiates -> a referenced-but-absent entity, reported in ## Decisions at S3 (a reference asserting a nonexistent record IS a contradiction finding, the only in-rule path to S3) naming rule ID + entity + relationship. The System entity type, expected via E3 but with nothing referencing it, is NOT a contradiction — it routes to ## Unknowns, is excluded from the denominator, and is NAMED in the coverage note. LOAD-BEARING: the entity-type coverage line renders (types in denominator vs excluded) — its absence FAILs even when a tier banner is present, because once every tier holds a record the banner falls silent while most entity types stay unpopulated. MM-0 renders 0-100 with all three factors as n/d. Seeded-clean R-PROJ-041 is NOT flagged. PASS iff the absent-but-referenced entity is S3 in ## Decisions, the unreferenced absent type is excluded-and-named in ## Unknowns, the type line renders, and the clean record is not flagged. Judge: judges/structure.md; case: cases/structure-missing-entity.yaml.

evals.name: structure-empty-required-field-counted-once
evals.expected_output: VIOLATION CLASS 2 of 3 (empty required field): R-PROJ-040 carries owner_person_id as an EMPTY SLOT. LOAD-BEARING DOUBLE-REPORT ASSERTION: an empty slot instantiates NO relationship rule, so it is a presence failure counted ONCE in the fields factor (MM-2) and never also in the relationships factor (MM-3) — counting it twice is an automatic FAIL. The finding names rule ID + entity + field (V-CORE-05 · RAID Item R-PROJ-040 · owning_agent empty) and routes to ## Decisions because the correct value is NOT derivable from the frozen schema — HIGH confidence alone does not admit it to ## Auto-Actionable. DERIVABILITY GATE: a field the frozen schema pins to exactly one value for that entity IS derivable and DOES route to ## Auto-Actionable with a TRACKER_UPDATES: block — the two must be distinguished. Optional fields left blank are NOT violations and never enter the denominator. The entity-type coverage line renders. PASS iff the empty required field is reported once in the fields factor only, the derivable/non-derivable split routes correctly, and no optional field is flagged. Judge: judges/structure.md; case: cases/structure-empty-required-field.yaml.

evals.name: structure-broken-relationship-tier-gap-discriminated
evals.expected_output: VIOLATION CLASS 3 of 3 (broken relationship): R-PROJ-038's owner_person_id is POPULATED but names a Person id with no record, WHILE the cross-project-shared tier holds >=1 record — a genuine dangling reference, reported in ## Decisions naming rule ID + entity + relationship. LOAD-BEARING ROUTING-ORDER ASSERTION: a reference unresolvable because its target TIER is unpopulated is routing row 1 (first-match-wins) and routes to ## Unknowns, excluded from the denominator and named in the coverage note — it is NEVER reported as a per-record contradiction. The two cases must be discriminated: populated-but-unresolvable-with-a-populated-tier is a record defect; unresolvable-because-the-tier-is-empty is a coverage gap. The seeded-clean resolving Person reference lands in ## Confirmed precisely BECAUSE the tier is populated. A constraint deferred to lifecycle automation is structurally excluded and declared with its reason. The tier banner, when rendered, is a LIST derived from the unpopulated-tier set — never singular, never a hardcoded count. PASS iff the dangling reference is a record defect in ## Decisions, the tier-gap reference is excluded-and-named in ## Unknowns rather than blamed on a record, and the resolving reference is Confirmed. Judge: judges/structure.md; case: cases/structure-broken-relationship.yaml.
